battle.name: 歧亭、延州之戰
battle.brief: 開皇九年正月，隋滅陳之役西線開打。行軍元帥楊素領水軍自狼尾灘順流東下，前鋒大將軍劉仁恩進抵宜昌西陵峽口，遇上南陳荊州刺史陳慧紀所遣南康內史呂忠肅屯兵歧亭。陳軍依兩岸巖石築城拒守，隋軍以五牙大艦所載擲石機擊破岩城，乘勝追至延洲，陳軍再潰，江陵遂開。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 此役屬隋滅陳之戰的西線戰鬥，交戰雙方為南陳與隋朝。南陳方面，荊州刺史陳慧紀總領荊襄一帶防務，節制江陵以西的城池與沿江營伍；南康內史呂忠肅領兵屯守歧亭，佔據西陵峽口的兩岸巖石，並在延洲一帶安置接應部隊。陳後主陳叔寶坐鎮建康，以蕭摩訶、淳于量等將領守江防要地，與荊州戰線遙遙相望。隋朝方面，行軍元帥楊素都督諸軍，節制水陸兩師；大將軍劉仁恩率步騎為前鋒，率舟師順長江東下；東面尚有賀若弼自廣陵、晉王楊廣自六合兩路大軍同時壓境，隋文帝楊堅在建康未破之前不肯輕易分兵，使荊州線成為吸引陳軍北援、牽制陳方增援的鉗形。除舟師之外，江北與襄漢沿江諸州提供的匠戶、船工與糧秣，共同構成本次攻勢的後勤體系。
countriesEn: This engagement was the western front of the Sui conquest of Chen, fought between the Southern Chen court and the Sui dynasty. On the Chen side, Chen Huiji, governor of Jingzhou, held overall responsibility for the defence of the Jing and Xiang regions, administering the walled towns west of Jiangling together with the garrison posts along the river; Lü Zhongsu, commandant of Nankang, led the detachment that was stationed at Qiting, occupying the rock faces on both banks of the Xiling gorge mouth and posting support troops in the region of Yanzhou. The Chen emperor Chen Shubao remained at Jiankang, with such generals as Xiao Mohe and Chunyu Liang holding the key river positions, in constant mutual support with the Jingzhou line. On the Sui side, Yang Su, appointed commander-in-chief of the campaign, exercised authority over both the fleet and the land army; Liu Ren'en, a Sui general, led the vanguard of infantry and cavalry, and his flotilla moved down the Yangtze. At the same time, on the eastern front, He Ruobi was advancing from Guangling and Prince Yang Guang from Liuhe. Because the Sui emperor Yang Jian was unwilling to divide his forces before Jiankang had fallen, the Jingzhou front was used as a pincer: it drew Chen troops northward and kept reinforcements away from the river crossing. Beyond the ships themselves, the craftsmen, boatmen and grain crews supplied by the provinces along the river to the north and in the Hanyang region formed the logistical base of the whole offensive.
people: 楊素是此役的關鍵人物，安定郿原出身，隋朝開國功臣，自開皇初年平定江南殘部以來屢獨當一面，開皇九年受命為行軍元帥，總攬伐陳諸軍。他不用尋常舟師開路，而以新造的五牙大艦作前驅，把攻城器械直接裝上戰船，顯示出以艦船代城、以機械取巖的作戰取向。劉仁恩為隋軍前鋒，領步騎先期挺進至夷陵一帶，掩護舟師展開。陳方主事者為荊州刺史陳慧紀，坐鎮江陵統攝西面防務；南康內史呂忠肅以一部兵力據險拒守，是歧亭、延洲兩地實際的守將，兵敗之後其下落史無明文記載。東端的蕭摩訶、淳于量奉命守京口，牽制隋軍主力，使陳慧紀無法得到援兵。隋文帝楊堅自長安遙制戰局，下令限期渡江，戰與和的取捨在朝議中並非沒有爭議，一再催促楊素不得遲疑。
peopleEn: Yang Su was the decisive figure of this campaign. A native of Meiyuan in Dingxi, he was one of the founding generals of the Sui and had repeatedly fought as an independent commander since the early Kaihuang years, suppressing the surviving Chen forces in the south; in the ninth year of Kaihuang he was appointed commander-in-chief of the campaign against Chen and given control of all the armies engaged. He did not advance with ordinary river craft but with newly built five-toothed great ships, and he mounted siege engines directly on his hulls, showing a clear preference for using ships in place of siege towers and machinery in place of assault. Liu Ren'en led the vanguard of the Sui force, taking infantry and cavalry forward to the Yiling area in advance so as to cover the deployment of the flotilla. On the Chen side the officer in charge was Chen Huiji, governor of Jingzhou, who sat at Jiangling and directed the western defences; Lü Zhongsu, commandant of Nankang, held a position in the hills with a single detachment and was the actual commander at both Qiting and Yanzhou, and after his defeat no historical source records what became of him. At the eastern end, Xiao Mohe and Chunyu Liang had been assigned to hold Jiankang and to pin down the main Sui armies, so that no reinforcements could reach Chen Huiji. The Sui emperor Yang Jian directed the war from Chang'an, ordering the crossing to be executed by a set date; the choice between fighting and negotiating was not free of dispute at court, and he pressed Yang Su repeatedly not to delay.
kits: 此役最能說明兵器位置的，是隋軍船隊上的擲石機，即投石機。所謂投石機，最早是希臘化時代的攻城裝置，以槓桿與配重把蓄勢轉化成飛石，羅德島攻防戰中已見其用；漢末以來，這類器械隨胡人東來，中原稱之為石砲、拋石，攻城奪壘屢建其功。開皇九年，楊素把這種機械裝上五牙大艦：五牙樓高十丈，每艦置擲石機六架，艦內外另備戰船千餘艘，專以擊打巖壁與城頭。與之相配的還有撞竿一類的撞擊器具與火攻器具，隋軍以大艦逼近陳軍巖城，一邊拋石，一邊以艦身撞擊岸壁，逼陳兵離開洞口。陳軍方面則倚賴兩岸巖石築成的山城，以弩、弓及投石抵禦，並用火船與拒馬阻擋隋軍靠近。雙方的舟船、弩機、糧秣與甲胄，共同構成江道攻防的物資基礎。
kitsEn: The equipment that best illustrates the place of the weapon in this battle is the stone-throwing engine carried by the Sui fleet, the onager. Such engines were first built in the Hellenistic world, converting stored force through a lever and a counterweight into a flying stone; they are attested at the defence of Rhodes. Since the late Han period the device had travelled east with the steppe peoples, and in the Chinese plains it was known as the stone ballista or the pao-shu, and repeatedly earned its keep in assaults on walled towns. In the ninth year of Kaihuang Yang Su mounted exactly this machine on his five-toothed great ships: the tower stood ten zhang high, each hull carried six throwing engines, and several hundred fighting craft rode inside and alongside, all of it meant for smashing rock faces and parapets. Alongside it came equipment for ramming and for fire attack. The Sui drove the great ships right up against the Chen rock-forts, hurling stones on one side while the hulls battered the cliffs on the other, forcing the defenders out of their caves. The Chen relied on the rock-walled towns built along both banks, answering with crossbows, bows and stone missiles, and used fire boats and caltrops to hold the Sui off. The boats, crossbow mechanisms, grain and armour of both sides together formed the material basis of this contest on the river.
tactics: 隋軍的戰術核心是以艦當城。歧亭一段江面狹窄、水勢湍急，陳軍依兩岸巖石開鑿洞穴、築城拒守，居高臨下以弓弩與石砲俯射江面，使隋軍舟師難以展開。楊素不與守軍爭一時地盤，而是把五牙大艦直接駛至巖壁之下，以艦上的擲石機連續拋擊，擊毀洞口與城頭的防禦工事，同時以艦體撞擊岸壁，驅使陳兵離開掩體；再以火船與火炬焚燒陳軍泊於江邊的舟船，斷其接濟。前鋒劉仁恩所領步騎同時在兩岸上岸策應，掩護舟師作業，使陳軍無法迂迴到側面。延洲一役延用同一套路：先以機械消耗城防，再以壓倒性的兵力登岸奪取城池，陳慧紀布置的接應兵一經接觸便告瓦解。整條戰線上，隋軍水陸協同、器械先行的辦法，與陳軍依險固守的思路，構成本役最鮮明的對照。
tacticsEn: The core of the Sui method was to use the ship in place of the siege tower. At Qiting the river was narrow and the current swift, and the Chen had cut caves into the rock on both banks and built a wall across them, shooting down at the water with bows and stone missiles from above, so that the Sui flotilla could hardly open out. Yang Su did not try to win ground in a hurry; instead he drove the five-toothed great ships directly beneath the cliff face, worked the throwing engines continuously until the cave mouths and the parapets were broken down, and at the same time let the hulls ram the shore so as to drive the defenders out of their cover. Fire boats and torches were then sent in against the Chen craft moored at the bank to cut their supply. The infantry and cavalry of Liu Ren'en's vanguard landed on both banks to give support and cover the working parties, so that the Chen could not turn the position. The same script was used at Yanzhou: the defences were worn down by machinery first, and only then was the town carried by an overwhelming landing force, and the relief troops that Chen Huiji had posted broke up the moment they came into contact. Along the whole front, the Sui combination of water and land working together with machines in front, set against the Chen habit of holding fast to difficult ground, forms the sharpest contrast of this campaign.
data: 時間上，狼尾灘之戰在開皇八年十二月，歧亭、延洲接戰在開皇九年正月，即公元589年初。距離上，歧亭在西陵峽口，延洲在枝江一帶，兩地順流相去約百餘里，自延洲再順流至江陵又約三百餘里，隋軍水師在峽江中多迂迴並行。器械方面，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》所記五牙大艦的形制大致相同：樓高十丈，每艦置擲石機六架，艦內外備戰船千餘艘，五牙樓高於尋常樓船，可越過巖城頭部俯射。兵力方面，隋軍伐陳之眾通常記為五十餘萬，其中水陸之師主力集結於江漢下游與江淮一段；陳軍荊州線的具體兵數史無明文，僅知呂忠肅所部是陳慧紀分遣的一支偏師。隋軍糧秣自襄、漢及巴蜀沿江轉運，前線屯糧於江陵、襄陽一帶，樓船雖巨，給養仍靠水陸並行。
dataEn: As to time, the action at Langweitan belongs to the twelfth month of the eighth year of Kaihuang, while the fighting at Qiting and Yanzhou took place in the first month of the ninth year, that is at the beginning of 589 AD. As to distance, Qiting lay at the mouth of the Xiling gorge and Yanzhou lay in the region of Zhijiang, about a hundred li apart along the current, and from Yanzhou the river ran a further three hundred li or so down to Jiangling; the Sui flotilla had to proceed by a winding route through the gorge reaches. As to machinery, the accounts of the five-toothed great ships in the History of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror agree closely: the tower was ten zhang high, each hull carried six throwing engines, several hundred fighting ships were carried inside and alongside, and the tower stood higher than an ordinary fighting tower, allowing it to fire over the head of the rock fort. As to numbers of men, the Sui force invading Chen is usually given as more than five hundred thousand, with the bulk of the water and land armies concentrated along the lower river and the stretch between the Yangtze and the Huai; the exact strength of the Chen force on the Jingzhou line is not recorded, and all that is known is that Lü Zhongsu's detachment was a detached force sent out by Chen Huiji. The Sui grain and provisions were moved down the river from Xiang, Hanyang and the Ba-Shu region, with depots at Jiangling and Xiangyang; the great ships were huge, but the army still lived off transport carried both by water and by land.
cause: 此役的起因，最遠可追到隋文帝開皇年間的統一之志。隋承北周而已控北方，江南仍為陳朝所據；陳主荒於酒色，政事不修，兩邊的邊境衝突與流民糾紛日益累積。開皇八年，隋文帝詔令沿江諸州造船儲糧，準備大舉；朝中一度有人以久勞兵眾、國力未疲為由主和，蘇威進諫力陳時機不可再失，議遂定。開皇八年十二月，隋軍先以夜襲焚燒陳軍舟船於狼尾灘，取勝之後，開皇九年正月全線出擊：賀若弼自廣陵、晉王楊廣自六合渡江，楊素自西線順流而下，三面同時壓向陳之疆土。西線的作用，正在於奪取陳朝最後的西面屏障，切斷荊襄與建康之間的聯繫，使陳軍在江防正面崩潰時無從增援。歧亭、延洲因此不是孤立的遭遇戰，而是整個滅陳計畫中負責斷西的一支。
causeEn: The origins of this engagement can be traced back to the unification ambition of the Sui emperor during the Kaihuang years. The Sui had inherited the Northern Zhou and already held the north, while the south of the river remained in the hands of the Chen; the Chen ruler was given to drink and pleasure, government had gone slack, and border incidents and disputes over displaced people grew steadily worse on both sides. In the eighth year of Kaihuang the Sui emperor ordered the provinces along the river to build ships and store grain in preparation for a great campaign; at court there was a moment when those who urged a negotiated peace argued that the troops had laboured too long and the country's strength was not yet exhausted, but Su Wei remonstrated and argued that the moment must not be lost again, and the decision was settled. In the twelfth month of the eighth year the Sui army struck first, attacking the Chen fleet by night at Langweitan and burning their ships; after that success the whole line attacked in the first month of the ninth year: He Ruobi crossed from Guangling, Prince Yang Guang from Liuhe, and Yang Su came down from the west, so that three fronts pressed on the Chen at once. The function of the western front was precisely to seize the last western shield of the Chen, to cut the link between Jing and Xiang and Jiankang, and to leave the Chen army with no means of reinforcement when the river defences collapsed in the east. Qiting and Yanzhou were therefore not an isolated meeting engagement but the part of the plan of destroying Chen charged with cutting off the west.
impact: 荊州陷落，是陳朝崩解的起點。陳朝倚江而立的屏障，本來是西起巴蜀、東至建康的一道縱深防線；歧亭與延洲相繼失守之後，江陵失去外衛，建康與西部之間的聯繫只剩下江陵一道孤城，隋軍主力在正面渡江時已不必再擔心側翼。開皇九年三月，隋軍入建康，陳後主被俘，陳朝亡國，南北分裂近三百年的局面告終。戰役的後果遠超陳朝本身：隋朝在長江中游取得江陵這一座控制上、中游的樞紐，其後興建的大運河以江陵為樞軸，把江南的糧米與絲織品經漢水、汴水送到洛陽與涿郡，隋唐盛世所倚賴的物資循環即以此地為節點。器械面上，隋軍把擲石機配裝於巨型樓船的作法，也被後來的唐朝在攻打高句麗時沿用，成為中國古代水軍攻城的重要手段。
impactEn: The fall of Jingzhou was the beginning of the Chen state's collapse. The barrier the Chen had raised along the river was in truth a deep system of defence running from Ba-Shu in the west to Jiankang in the east; once Qiting and Yanzhou had fallen in turn, Jiangling lost its outworks, and the only thing left connecting Jiankang with the west was the single city of Jiangling, so that when the main Sui armies crossed the river in the east they no longer had to fear their flank. In the third month of the ninth year of Kaihuang the Sui army entered Jiankang, the Chen emperor was taken prisoner, the Chen state perished, and a division that had lasted for close to three hundred years came to an end. The consequences of the campaign reach far beyond the Chen itself: by taking Jiangling, the pivot of the middle and upper river, the Sui gained a node on which the great canal built in later years was hung, carrying the grain and the silk of the south up the Han and the Bian to Luoyang and to Zhuojun, and the circulation of goods on which the Sui and Tang prosperity rested ran through this place. In terms of machinery, the practice of fitting throwing engines to enormous tower ships was taken up later by the Tang in their wars against Goguryeo, and became an important method of river-borne siege in Chinese history.
result: 歧亭與延洲兩戰，隋軍皆克。歧亭一役，陳軍依巖石築起的山城在擲石機的連續拋擊與大艦撞擊之下失去抵抗能力，呂忠肅所部崩散，陳軍退保延洲；延洲一役，隋軍乘勝而至，陳慧紀布置的接應兵一併潰散，荊州刺史陳慧紀棄州奔建康，隋軍遂入江陵，江陵及荊、襄一線的城池望風歸附。陳朝在長江中游的最後防線至此瓦解，荊州、襄州盡為隋軍所有，隋軍得以由西面迂迴建康，與賀若弼、楊廣兩路主力形成三面夾擊之勢。開皇九年三月，隋軍入建康，陳朝覆亡。呂忠肅本人於亂軍中的去向，各史均無記載，其部眾或降或散，多被編入隋軍水師與屯田隊伍。這場戰役留下的經驗，被後來的隋唐統帥總結為一句話：長江天塹可以守，卻守不住水軍與攻城器械同時上手的對手。
resultEn: Both battles, at Qiting and at Yanzhou, were won by the Sui. At Qiting the rock-walled town built by the Chen lost its power to resist under the continuous stone-throwing of the engines and the ramming of the great ships; Lü Zhongsu's command broke up and the Chen fell back to Yanzhou. At Yanzhou the Sui came on in pursuit, the relief troops posted by Chen Huiji dissolved with them, and Chen Huiji, governor of Jingzhou, abandoned his province and fled to Jiankang, whereupon the Sui entered Jiangling and the towns of the Jing and Xiang lines submitted in the face of the advance. The last defensive line of the Chen in the middle river was broken, Jingzhou and Xiangzhou passed wholly into Sui hands, and the Sui were able to turn Jiankang from the west, so that the forces of He Ruobi and of Yang Guang closed on the city from three sides. In the third month of the ninth year of Kaihuang the Sui army entered Jiankang and the Chen state was destroyed. What became of Lü Zhongsu himself amid the rout is not recorded in any history; his men surrendered or scattered, and many were enrolled in the Sui fleets and in garrison and farming units. The lesson left by this campaign was summed up by the Sui and Tang commanders in a single line: the Yangtze may be held, but it cannot be held against an enemy who brings river craft and siege engines to bear at the same time.
